title: Sit at My Right Hand

questions.question: The Lord says to my Lord: "Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 110:1 (ESV): "...until I make your enemies your footstool."

questions.question: The Lord sends forth from Zion your mighty scepter. Rule in the midst of your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 110:2 (ESV): "Rule in the midst of your enemies!"

questions.question: Your people will offer themselves freely on the day of your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 110:3 (ESV): "Your people will offer themselves freely on the day of your power,"

questions.question: In holy garments, from the womb of the morning, the dew of your youth will be what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 110:3 (ESV): "...the dew of your youth will be yours."

questions.question: The Lord has sworn and will not change his mind, "You are a priest how long?"
You are a priest forever after the order of whom?
The Lord is at your right hand; he will shatter kings on the day of his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 110:5 (ESV): "...he will shatter kings on the day of his wrath."

questions.question: He will execute judgment among the nations, filling them with what?
He will shatter chiefs over the wide what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 110:6 (ESV): "he will shatter chiefs over the wide earth."

questions.question: He will drink from the brook by the way; therefore he will lift up his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 110:7 (ESV): "...therefore he will lift up his head."

questions.question: Who is speaking in verse 1?
questions.explanation: Psalm 110:1 (ESV): "The Lord says to my Lord..."

questions.question: Who is the "my Lord" in verse 1?
questions.explanation: Interpreted as the Messiah in the New Testament (e.g., Matthew 22:44).

questions.question: What type of psalm is Psalm 110 considered?
From where does the Lord send forth the mighty scepter?
questions.explanation: Psalm 110:2 (ESV): "The Lord sends forth from Zion your mighty scepter."

questions.question: What will he do to the kings on the day of his wrath?
questions.explanation: Psalm 110:5 (ESV): "...he will shatter kings on the day of his wrath."

key_verse_text: The Lord says to my Lord: "Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool."
